input: I have crushing chest pressure radiating to my left arm and I'm sweating. It started 30 minutes ago.
My face suddenly started drooping on one side an hour ago and my speech is slurred.
The worst headache of my life hit me out of nowhere ten minutes ago, like a thunderclap. I'm also confused.
I've had a fever around 103F for two days and I feel awful, maybe 8 out of 10 bad. No stiff neck, no rash.
My back pain flared up yesterday and it's a 9 out of 10. No numbness, no bladder problems, no injury.
Severe ear pain since last night, I'd say 8 out of 10. My hearing is fine and I have no fever.
I've had a nagging cough for about two weeks. It's mild, maybe 3 out of 10, no blood, breathing is fine.
My knee has been achy for three weeks, around 4 out of 10. No swelling or fever, I can walk fine.
I've been unusually tired for about a month. Moderate, like 4 out of 10. Sleeping okay, no weight loss.
I keep getting headaches most afternoons for the past ten days, about 5 out of 10. Nothing sudden or severe.
I woke up with a scratchy sore throat this morning. It's mild, 2 out of 10, I can swallow and breathe fine.
I felt a little queasy after dinner last night, maybe 2 out of 10. I'm keeping fluids down fine today.
I noticed a small itchy rash on my wrist yesterday, very mild, 1 out of 10. No fever, not spreading.
I just don't feel great lately.
My stomach has been a bit off.
